text: The UEBA system flagged SCH3858's activity this week due to atypical browsing behavior, specifically visits to job-search sites. This anomaly is notable because Sebastian Cooper Hoffman's recent typical behavior was 27.5 visits to such sites, and his actual count of 45 visits is significantly higher (z=3.34). Meanwhile, same-role peers have an average of only 1 visit this week, making SCH3858's behavior even more remarkable.
